records.card_text: De'Longhi Magnifica Start Espresso & Coffee Machine with Automatic Milk Frother. Also nearby. Current Price: $769.00. Walmart - ElectroCell & more. Free delivery. Rated 4.7 out of 5. 80 reviews. Go to product viewer for this item.

responses.message: I recommend the De’Longhi Magnifica Start with Automatic Milk Frother at $769, leaving $31 under your equipment limit. Its matched product page identifies the fully automatic model and automatic milk frother. I reasonably interpret this established whole-bean automatic machine as providing grinding, brewing and milk preparation with built-in equivalents of the usual portafilter and tamping equipment; the supplied evidence does not itemize every component. For two successive morning milk drinks, this workflow should be approachable. Routine milk-system cleaning remains necessary. The card identifies Walmart marketplace seller ElectroCell, alongside aggregated alternatives—not necessarily Walmart itself—and does not specify return terms. That seller uncertainty is the main qualification to my recommendation.
